conversation_followthrough.scope: Traceable resident-chosen reviews after heard speech, not proof that language caused an action or that a promise was fulfilled.

encounter_scheduling.scope: Captured proximity notices are opportunities, not consent, perception validation or completed encounters. Overlap is native frame evidence, not a realism score.

models.cost_coverage: Retained accepted results and claim-bound language rejection receipts. Older rejections and other failed calls may exist only in worker receipts; this is not a total bill.

wording.scope: Economic wording calls, including rejected responses and fixtures. Exact terms are preserved; surrounding claims and human realism are not independently verified.

bargaining.scope: Retained resident bargaining plans, including fixtures. Offers and accepted terms are not payments; paid prices require committed native inventory receipts.

negotiations.scope: Retained voiced trade plans, including staged experiments. Sales require committed inventory receipts; refusals are choices, not technical failures.

employment_encounters.scope: Employment requests and heard terms; output and wages require separate native production receipts. Includes controlled tests.

economy.speech_scope: Deterministic terms driven by resident decisions. Heard acceptance is not a committed sale. Includes staged protocol tests.
economy.pricing: Residents choose bids and counteroffers from bounded price options using personal history; legacy fixtures retain 3/5 offers. No market-clearing equilibrium is claimed.
economy.scope: Physical ledger includes explicitly staged integration experiments; not all outcomes prove autonomous economic behaviour.

resident_plans.scope: Retained economic/routine plans, including staged fixtures. Feasible options are not a realism score.

social_complexity.implemented_drama_mechanism: Subjective appraisal and affinity only; no multi-party conflict/resolution system.

realism.reason: No calibrated human ratings or interoperability benchmark. Completion, entropy and feature counts are not realism scores.

scene_handoffs.scope: Native scene release only. Not quest compatibility, successful agent action, or psychological realism.

relationships.scope: Only recorded directed relationships. Missing edges mean no relationship evidence, not hostility. Bands are authored gameplay rules; there is no forced friend quota.

dialogue_analysis.scope: Overlapping English keyword cues over delivered social lines, not semantic topics. A question mark is not proof of a question answered; conflict words do not prove drama. Pair counts include refused approaches.

agency.scope: Current save; retained waves and bounded personal memories, not lifetime telemetry. Goal coverage includes unloaded initialized residents. Claims are pending work, not continuous thinking. Known test models are excluded from result/outcome series; unlabelled legacy journey provenance remains explicit. Arrival implies no trade, work or need recovery.
agency.timing_scope: Provider inference time and decision-to-settlement wall time are separate. Settlement includes waiting and interruptions; it is not pure walking time. Missing historical timestamps remain unknown.
agency.attempt_scope: Attempt counts, inference-failure rate and billing coverage use explicit attempted=true receipts. Pre-inference skips remain rejected decisions but are not model calls. Legacy missing attempt markers are reported as unknown.
agency.cost_scope: Known provider costs include legacy reported costs; billing coverage uses explicitly attempted calls only. Missing costs are not zero and this is not a complete provider bill.

economic_network.scope: Committed physical receipts, including controlled integration experiments. Graph uses complete distinct buyer/seller IDs; unknown commodity labels are not guessed. Turnover is not profit, supply-chain depth or welfare. Seller concentration is transaction-count based, not market power or a target to maximize.

drama.scope: Directed gameplay relationships and heard history only. Affinity polarity is not a verified conflict, motive or human psychological measure. Event-linked multi-party conflict/resolution and independent memory-consistency review remain uninstrumented.

spatial_window.scope: Current native session and monotonic save segment only. Sampled 3D displacement in game units; no offline, paused-clock, cross-space or teleport time counted as stationary. Stationary includes legitimate conversation, work and rest. Travel intention is not observed movement; neither proves human realism.

quality_goals.source: Authored engineering targets, not validated human or city norms

items.scope: Loaded managed actor-seconds between paired samples; excludes missing time, paused clock and invalid geometry from the numerator.
A personal goal exists; this does not prove economic usefulness or continuous reasoning.

items.measure: Businesses with measured queues and throughput
